source: make a PvP arena with detail

image_prompt.text: Large columns scattered across the arena floor so a retreating fighter can break line of sight
Open ring-out edges around the arena that punish over-aggressive positioning
Spawns set back and screened so nobody appears in an opponent line of fire
a high level of prop and surface detail throughout the arena

layout_placement.text: Anti-camp spawn placement on opposing sides of the arena

notes: Everything in this build except the detail request came from the preset - the prompt named only a PvP arena.
Flat arena chosen deliberately: verticality is a style choice with real pipeline cost, not a requirement of the genre.
No player or team count was given, so spawn counts are unresolved.

open_questions.ask: What should the arena look like - a fantasy colosseum, a neon sci-fi ring, a modern gym?
How many players, and is it one-versus-one, teams, or a free-for-all?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the arena look like - fantasy colosseum, neon sci-fi ring, modern gym?
How many players, and is it one-versus-one, teams, or free-for-all?
Melee or ranged? Ranged combat would make this a shooter map with lane discipline instead of a shared clash space.
How big should the arena floor be?

answers.ask: What should the arena look like - a fantasy colosseum, a neon sci-fi ring, a modern gym?
answers.answer: Use a fantasy colosseum theme, with detailed stone walls, arches, spectator stands, and a central combat floor.

answers.ask: How many players, and is it one-versus-one, teams, or a free-for-all?
answers.answer: Make it a small free-for-all arena for up to 8 players.
